newsitem.title: UK: BT sets telecoms jv with Japan's Marubeni.
newsitem.headline: BT sets telecoms jv with Japan's Marubeni.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed with Japan's Marubeni Corp to form a joint venture in Japan providing domestic and global communications services.

In a statement the companies said that from April 1 a new joint venture, BT Network Information Service (BT NIS), would be formed by combining an existing joint venture, NIS, and the British group's Japanese unit BT Japan.

"BT NIS will provide companies in Japan with the full range of domestic products and services currently available, as well as offering its customers direct access to the... services from Concert, BT and MCI Communications Corp's global communication services company," the statement said.
The venture will also offer international private line connections, Internet, intranet, video conferencing, Syncordia outsourcing services, domestic frame relay and voice resale.
"This company is now a real alternative supplier of domestic and truly global business communciations services," BT NIS president John Jarvis was quoted as saying.
The integrations will bring most of BT Japan's employees and facilities, and all its customers, into BT NIS to create one organisation with more than 200 staff and 10,000 customers.

BT's ongoing merger with MCI, the second biggest U.S. telephone company, will create a global giant with combined annual revenues of $42 billion, but some analysts have highlighted a need for the merged group to bolster its presence in Japan and elsewhere in Asia.
